statements.text: Brian Brotsos is Acting Chief Data and SI Officer (CDSIO) at the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT). Brian oversees DOT’s data strategy and SI integration, ensuring the Department not only effectively uses SI products, but also has the data frameworks and capabilities to support such tools.
